candidate.answerReason: The inner logarithm is 2, making the outer logarithm log_10(10) = 1. Squaring gives 1.

methods.label: Evaluate from the inside outward
methods.explanation:
A base-ten logarithm asks which power of \(10\) equals its argument. Since \(10^2=100\), we have \(\log_{10}100=2\). Therefore
\[
\left[\log_{10}\left(5\log_{10}100\right)\right]^2
=\left[\log_{10}(10)\right]^2
=1^2=1.
\]
Both logarithm arguments are positive, so the expression is defined. The value is \(\boxed{1}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{E}}\).
methods.levelReason: Only the definition of a logarithm and simple integer powers are needed, both permitted at AMC 12 level.
